description: Volume control for media players: a mute button with a slider next to it or in a menu.

props.direction: Orientation of the slider in the menu. The **inline** slider is always horizontal.
props.disabled: Disables the mute button and the slider.
props.inline: Shows the slider next to the button instead of in a menu. `true` places it after the button; `left` and `right` pin the side regardless of text direction. Pair with **slider-props** to set the slider width.
props.label: Passed to `aria-label` and, when **inline**, shown in a tooltip. Without it the label comes from the locale.
props.menuProps: Props passed to the VMenu holding the slider. The menu opens on hover and focus, and a click on the button toggles mute. On touch, a tap opens and closes the menu instead.
props.slider: `visible` shows the slider, `hover` keeps an **inline** slider collapsed until the control is hovered or focused, `hidden` leaves only the mute button. A menu always opens on hover, so `hover` has no effect there. The slider is always hidden on iOS and iPadOS, which ignore volume set from JavaScript.
props.sliderProps: Props passed to the slider, e.g. `color`, `step` or `width`.

exposed.toggleMuted: Switches between 0 and the last non-zero volume.
